[REGISTER NOW](https://go.vertexinc.com/l/514851/2026-08-31/k1jnyj) 30 minutes About This Event


Manufacturers are navigating shifting trade policies, supply chain disruption, cost pressures, ERP modernization, and expanding global compliance requirements. As operations change, tax complexity can surface across procurement, production, intercompany activity and distribution, particularly for organizations operating across multiple plants, jurisdictions and systems.


Join Vertex for a timely discussion about the trends affecting manufacturers today. The panel will share practical insights on managing supply chain change, improving procurement tax accuracy, maintaining consistency through ERP transformation, and preparing for evolving digital compliance requirements.


## What attendees will learn:


- How to respond to supply chain and sourcing changes without creating inconsistent tax outcomes
- How to maintain consistency during ERP modernization and cloud migration
- How to prepare systems and data for expanding digital tax and reporting requirements
